visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard, wearing a black baseball cap and an olive green long-sleeved shirt, sits in a specialized black racing simulator seat featuring prominent Logitech branding. He points his left hand towards a large monitor displaying a first-person perspective of a race car on a paved track. The setting is a brightly lit Logi Store retail environment with blue and purple accent lighting. White and yellow subtitles and various brand logos appear at the bottom and top of the frame. (2) The scene transitions to a series of close-up shots focusing on the simulator hardware and the man's interactions. His hands, adorned with beaded bracelets, grip a high-tech steering wheel with multicolored buttons, and his feet, wearing black and white sneakers, press down on metallic pedals. The monitor in the background shows a car navigating a winding road lined with autumn trees. Subtitles and a McLaren brand logo are clearly visible on the screen. (3) The man stands upright next to a large vertical promotional poster that features a racing driver in a blue and yellow suit along with several QR codes. He uses his right hand to gesture towards different sections of the informative text on the board. The background displays shelves filled with retail boxes of gaming headsets and other peripherals. Subtitles continue to cycle at the bottom of the visual frame. (4) A wide shot captures the modern store interior with a large glowing Logitech sign before cutting back to the man in the racing seat. He holds a smartphone to take a photo of the monitor, which now displays race statistics and a lap time. He then turns to the camera, smiling and waving his hand while pulling a gear shifter. Subtitles and a store location name are visible as overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking enthusiastically in Mandarin, characterized by a clear, moderate pitch and high energy. Simultaneously, an upbeat electronic background track with a prominent, driving beat starts. Low-frequency engine idling and revving sounds from the racing simulation are audible, creating a layered acoustic environment. (2) A distinct "whoosh" transition sound effect triggers a shift in the narration as the man describes the competition details. The male speaker's voice maintains a high level of arousal and clarity. The background music continues with its fast-paced electronic rhythm, while the mechanical sound of a racing engine revving higher is prominently mixed. (3) A bright, digital "ding" sound effect occurs to emphasize the promotional prize of a trip to the UK. The narrator's speech rate remains fast and engaging, with no audible strain. The electronic music features synthesized lead lines and a steady percussion section that enhances the promotional excitement. (4) Short, percussive clicking sounds from a mechanical keyboard are clearly heard for a brief duration as the man points to the computer screen. The male narrator continues his energetic delivery, describing the steps to enter the contest while the background music volume remains constant and driving. (5) A sharp, realistic camera shutter sound effect is played, signaling the moment the man takes a photo of his race score. The background music starts its concluding section, and the engine sounds from the game become more distant and muted while the vocal articulation remains professional. (6) The narration reaches its conclusion with a warm and inviting tone, encouraging viewers to participate in the event. The background music ends on a final electronic swell, followed by a moment of complete studio silence. The overall audio production quality is extremely polished and clean.
